entries.reason: The response is a click on the map picture, so a participant must be able to see the picture and reply with a position; the codebook gives no reply format for it. The picture is supplied in the codebook, but the AI participants launched by the replay runner receive text only.
entries.impact: The effect is not run unless the participant is vision-capable; with a text-only participant the conditions would read identically or the task cannot be done.
entries.suggested_action: Decide whether to run this effect with a vision-capable participant (the package passes the picture files to such a participant) or to exclude it.

entries.reason: The disfluency manipulation is a visual font property that a text-only AI participant cannot perceive.
